introduction: Help the hermit, follow the tomb and word-puzzle clues, collect Surok’s five distinct adamantite chunks, and choose the jade statue’s trophy, token and collar exchanges. Keep personal investigation, current proof and recorded outcomes distinct.
orientation: The northern passage of the Undead Outpost leads EAST onto the Crypt’s forest trail. WEST from the trail returns there. Follow the trail around the graveyard to the hermit’s cabin. Burned bridge, river, lake, underwater passage and waterfall are real terrain; source metadata is not a promise of safe access.

Ask the hermit hello, hi, howdy or name for his request, hunting or hunt about game, and graveyard, strange, scared or tomb about the danger. Ask Surok hello, hi or name, or crypt, dungeon, catacomb or catacombs. The jade statue answers hello, hi, howdy or name without explaining its recipes. These six response families have twenty-one aliases; keywords are not individual achievements.

The hermit needs exactly four kindling sticks and two branches, all loose together. The many trail floor sources are different from the log, charred timber and other wood. He reveals a key-location clue and departs. The rusted tomb key already starts hidden on the eastern trail; no item reward, campfire action or personal hermit receipt is required to recover it.

The rusted key unlocks the northern tomb door. Inspect and PUSH the fixed gargoyle head to open the blocked downward slab. A loose-stone switch at the staircase opens the upward slab. These are actual shared controls, but the journal does not yet record personal operation or passage clearance.

The banquet-hall torch is a fixed PULL switch for the east wall into the scat pit. Nakral’s fixed bone throne is a PUSH switch opening the north passage into the earthen tunnel. The controls open their declared blocked exits; looking at a torch or throne, another player’s operation or an already-open passage is not your recorded action.

Three note fragments contain parts of the word puzzle: the mostly burnt note in charred embers, the scrap carried by the orc shaman, and the scrap carried by the tall dark creature. Read their descriptions and combine the fragments. SAY the combined word near the special iron door; the real magic-door handler unlocks it. Reading and successful unlocking currently have no personal durable journal milestone.

Surok in the morgue needs all five distinct adamantite chunks, one from each of the mapped sites. They look identical. Four are floor sources; the fifth is inside a locked wooden chest in a secret ironwood alcove. Same-name duplicates from another site cannot replace a missing kind. His four-or-five dialogue is only a clue; the accepted recipe is exactly five.

The jade statue’s first exchange uses iron butterfly wings, a black imp tail, a magma horn and a white wolf ear together for a stone token. The token can then be exchanged for a moss-covered bracelet. A supplied token fits without personal earlier trophy history; the earlier receipt never replaces the current token.

The imprisoned hell hound’s original mithril collar is a separate statue input for an enhanced collar. Input and reward have identical names but different identities. Token-to-bracelet and collar enhancement each make the statue depart. They are distinct outcomes that need a fresh recipient episode if you want both; the four-trophy exchange alone keeps it present.

Nakral’s journal has separate page17 and page24 descriptions explaining his research and moral decline. Other papers, formulae, corpses, scratchings, the imported father-spirit object and ordinary combat provide context. Reading, rescuing a prisoner, defeating a mutant or ending all experiments is not an invented accepted quest endpoint. The magical fountain has an existing shared drinking effect, separate from story credit.

The cavern’s authored UP exit points to an old surface room absent from the active world; the loader removes unresolved exits. Do not rely on that surface route. The fixed glowing orb near the old skeleton is an existing TOUCH return to the graveyard trail, subject to the shared travel rules. It remains non-takeable; no portable escape capability is added.

Current loose materials, earlier accepted receipts, original source, gifts, learned words, keys, switches, movement, combat, epic claims and final rewards are distinct facts. Five static daily candidates depend on real material and recipient renewal under native mode1; reset declarations do not prove availability. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen recovery is separate. No native zone repair or mobility change ships.

contacts.name: an old hermit
contacts.description: Starts in his cabin and requests four kindling sticks plus two branches. The native thanks gives a key-location clue and makes him depart; the cabin’s rent service is separate.

contacts.name: a dwarven conjurer
contacts.description: Starts in the morgue and exchanges five distinct same-named adamantite chunks for gloves, then departs. His four-or-five dialogue does not reduce the required bundle.

contacts.name: a squat statue
contacts.description: Starts in the small room and accepts three different exchanges. Four trophies yield a token without departure; the token or original collar each selects a different reward and makes the statue depart.

contacts.name: a tiny iron butterfly
contacts.description: The iron butterfly follows the iron golem at the small chamber and starts carrying the exact wings. The golem’s equipment is separate from the follower’s quest proof.

contacts.name: a grinning imp
contacts.description: The black imp follows the hyena at the obsidian chamber and starts carrying the exact tail. The hyena’s obsidian collar is a different item.

contacts.name: a small magma devil
contacts.description: The magma devil follows the formless mass in the pumice chamber and starts carrying the magma horn and warm key, wearing a pumice ring. Only the horn is statue proof; the key opens the pumice chest.

contacts.name: a snow-white wolf
contacts.description: The white wolf follows the frost dervish in the small chamber and starts carrying its ear and an iron collar. Only the exact ear enters the trophy bundle.

contacts.name: a chained hellhound
contacts.description: The imprisoned hell hound starts wearing the original glowing mithril collar. Recovery, removal and personal kill proof remain separate.

contacts.name: Nak'ral, keeper of the crypt
contacts.description: Theodeus Nak’ral starts in the laboratory carrying an imported epic stone and potion, equipped with robe, bracelet and staff. His research journal is a separate fixed island-container source. Combat and a committed group epic claim are not extra native item-quest receipts.

stories.title: Hermit: bring the exact firewood bundle
stories.summary: Bring four kindling sticks and two branches together. The hermit thanks you, reveals where he threw a tomb key, and departs. The recipe gives a clue, not a key item or a stove-lighting outcome. The key already has its own floor source; hearing the clue is not required to recover it.
